title: Translate entire app UI from English to Hindi

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text in the Navigation component from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All navigation link labels are displayed in Hindi.
Mobile menu toggle and close labels are in Hindi.
Admin link label is in Hindi when visible.

file_operations.description: Replace all English navigation text with Hindi translations: nav links (होम, हमारे बारे में, कार्यक्रम, दर्शन, संसाधन, संपर्क करें, दान करें), mobile menu labels (मेन्यू, बंद करें), and admin link (व्यवस्थापक).

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text in the Hero component from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: Hero tagline and mission statement are in Hindi.
CTA button labels (support, learn more) are in Hindi.
Scroll indicator label is in Hindi if present.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: organization tagline, mission statement, CTA button labels (हमारा समर्थन करें, और जानें), and scroll indicator text (नीचे स्क्रॉल करें). Preserve existing Sanskrit terms unchanged.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text in the Mission component from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: Section heading and introductory paragraph are in Hindi.
All four core value card titles (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) and their descriptions are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: section heading (हमारा मिशन), introductory paragraph, and all four core value titles and descriptions (भक्ति, सुरक्षा, ज्ञान, एकता with corresponding Hindi descriptions).

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text in the SupportOptions component from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All support option titles and descriptions are in Hindi.
CTA link labels are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: section heading (सहयोग के तरीके), all four support option titles and descriptions (स्वयंसेवक बनें, जागरूकता फैलाएं, कौशल साझा करें, ज्ञान दान करें), and CTA link labels (और जानें).

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Home page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All Home page section headings, highlight titles, descriptions, and button labels are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: section headings, four highlight card titles and descriptions (सांस्कृतिक संरक्षण, आध्यात्मिक शिक्षा, समुदाय निर्माण, सामाजिक सेवा), CTA section text, and button labels (दान करें, हमसे जुड़ें).

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the About page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: About page hero text, story content, and all principle cards are fully in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: hero section heading and subtitle, organization story paragraphs, and all four principle card titles and descriptions (उद्देश्य, दृष्टि, मूल्य, समुदाय).

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Programs page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All program card titles, descriptions, and impact statistic labels are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: section headings (हमारे कार्यक्रम), all six program card titles and descriptions (वैदिक अध्ययन, सांस्कृतिक उत्सव, युवा शिक्षा, सामुदायिक सभाएं, सामाजिक कल्याण, विरासत संरक्षण), and impact statistics labels.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Philosophy page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All Philosophy page headings, principle titles, and descriptive body text are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: section headings, principle titles, body text explaining Sanatana Dharma, and devotion examples (Ram, Hanuman, Yudhishthir). Preserve existing Sanskrit terms (शाश्वत प्रकृति, भक्ति योग) unchanged.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Resources page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: Resources page hero, category headings, item titles, and all labels are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: hero section heading and subtitle (आध्यात्मिक संसाधन), all resource category headings (पवित्र ग्रंथ, वीडियो व्याख्यान, लेख, डाउनलोड सामग्री), item titles, and descriptive text.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Contact page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All form labels, placeholders, button text, and contact section labels are in Hindi.
Success and error messages shown after form submission are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: hero heading (संपर्क करें), form field labels (नाम, ईमेल, संदेश), placeholder text, submit button label (भेजें), contact information labels (पता, फ़ोन, ईमेल, सोशल मीडिया), success message (आपका संदेश सफलतापूर्वक भेजा गया), and error messages.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Donate page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All Donate page headings, impact labels, and commitment statements are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: section headings (हमारा समर्थन करें, प्रभाव क्षेत्र), support option descriptions, impact area labels with percentage breakdowns (सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम, शिक्षा, सामुदायिक सेवा, विरासत संरक्षण), and transparency commitment text.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text on the Admin page from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard headings, table headers, filter/search labels, and action buttons are all in Hindi.
Authorization and error messages on the Admin page are in Hindi.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: dashboard heading (व्यवस्थापक डैशबोर्ड), search field placeholder (खोजें), filter labels (क्रमबद्ध करें), table column headers (क्रमांक, नाम, ईमेल, संदेश, तिथि), action button labels (CSV निर्यात), authorization error message (आपको इस पृष्ठ तक पहुंचने के लिए व्यवस्थापक होना आवश्यक है), loading states, and empty state messages.

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text in the Footer component from English to Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All Footer section headings, link labels, and attribution text are in Hindi.
Dynamic year display and caffeine.ai attribution remain functional.

file_operations.description: Replace English text with Hindi: quick links section heading (त्वरित लिंक), navigation link labels (होम, हमारे बारे में, कार्यक्रम, दर्शन, संपर्क करें), contact section heading (संपर्क), social media section heading (हमसे जुड़ें), and attribution text (के साथ बनाया गया). Preserve organization name 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA' and maintain dynamic year and caffeine.ai link functionality.
